description_en: Modifies the endpoint type used for host O&M. Bastionhost supports O&M over the Internet and private networks
description_zh: 堡垒机支持公网运维和私网运维，您可以通过本接口修改运维主机时使用的连接地址类型
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-hosts-active-address-type --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-ids '["1","2"]' --active-address-type Private --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHostsActiveAddressType

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the host whose endpoint type you want to modify belongs.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The area ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the host whose endpoint type you want to modify belongs.

For more information about the mapping between area IDs and area names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。

区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts whose endpoint types you want to modify. The value is a character string in JSON format. You can specify up to 100 host IDs.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多可输入100个主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_ids

parameters.help_en:
The new endpoint type of the host. Valid values:

Public: Internet
Private: private network
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的主机连接地址的类型。取值：

Public：公网
Private：私网
parameters.name: active_address_type

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
